commentary_segments.text: The expression of parameter f for both the weak inver- T sion and strong inversion regions is taken from Chapter 1. Clearly, it depends on inversion coefficient i and L. The expression of the GBW with only f as a T parameter, is the same as previously mentioned. For the values chosen before, we find that the maximum GBW is about 1/16 of the f of the output device. T A two-stage Miller CMOS OTA can have a small GBW, provided we select proper values of L and i. The actual power consumption will depend on the capacitive load.
